title: Invert Unique
statement: Implement `solve(pairs)`. `pairs` is a list of `[key, value]` strings. Build a dict from value to key. If two pairs share a value, return the string `error` and do not return a partial dict. Otherwise return the inverted dict.
constraints: A repeated value is an error even if the keys differ
hints: Insert value to key one pair at a time.
If the value is already present, return error immediately.
The original key becomes the stored value.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: Inverting a mapping is safe only when values are unique.

editorial: Inverting a mapping is safe only when values are unique. A silent overwrite drops a key and the caller cannot tell. Checking membership before the insert turns that collision into an explicit error, which is the contract this function tests.
